I find it useful but sometimes overwhelming when pushed too far into its abstract complexities.
replies.Do you ever get anxious when thinking ab: Absolutely. The pressure to perform well academically has left me with lingering anxiety around advanced topics. replies.Did you ever use AI to support your math: Yes, I used an AI tool recently to help break down a difficult physics problem. It explained things clearly and gave me step-by-step solutions, which calmed my anxiety. However, I still prefer human explanations for deeper conceptual understanding.
